notes.content: The page names three order relations on the family of figures and emphasizes the first two induced on M. A bracketed nb describes the third induced order as less important as a specific structure on M. The two oblique NB notes assert that the first two induced orders on L are discrete and that G ≤ F implies G ≪ F. Three aligned entries define sous-figure, raffinement and subdivision. A subfigure X belonging to M is called a strate; the corresponding member for refinement lies in the grande ombre of F. The final section introduces compatibility and disjointness; compatibility is expressed as {F,G} being bounded above for ≤. The disjointness sentence continues off this page after “et leur”.
math_reading_decisions: The third comparison has a curved lower rule and is rendered preccurlyeq. This visual identification does not verify the order axioms.
The live first formula is G ≤ F; its overwritten F/G operands and earlier ambiguous comparison remain explicit.
Only =X is inserted above the first parenthesis. The small x/X in the next parenthesis remains uncertain.
The barred verbal m, singular disjoint and unhyphenated sous figures are preserved literally. No mathematical or grammatical normalization was applied.
The central material is a definition list rather than a diagram; ordinary tabular layout records it without adding an arrow graph.
No proof, targeted mathematical verification or computation was performed on this page.
author_doubts: No explicit authorial request to verify, question or expression of doubt occurs.
“[nb la relation d’ordre … est moins importante, comme structure spécifique dans M].” is an authorial qualification, not a proof or checking instruction.
The two “NB” notes call attention to assertions.
